description: Shrimp Basket is a Gulf Coast seafood restaurant serving fresh, hand-breaded shrimp, coastal classics, and Southern hospitality since 1993. With locations across the Southeast, Shrimp Basket offers dine-in, takeout, online ordering, and catering for seafood lovers seeking laid-back coastal flavor. Gulf seafood, coastal cocktails, and a warm welcome — every single time.
atmosphere: Casual coastal dining with Southern hospitality
